    Incomparability of peaks (Fischbacher, proof of Lemma 5.2, property (4)) #

    closeB: a linked list of segments whose peaks are pairwise incomparable except possibly the two end peaks, with every inner peak separating, admits no path from its last peak back to its first: splicing such a path into the last segment closes a cycle whose base is the first peak, and cyc_top puts the second peak below the first.

        ¬Reaches z.segs[i].c z.segs[j].c ∧ ¬Reaches z.segs[j].c z.segs[i].c

        The valleys of a good walk are pairwise incomparable (Fischbacher, proof of Lemma 5.2, property (5)).
